referenceFunction.includedProcesses: infrastructure materials including replacement parts during operation, transport and disposal of infastructure. Land use. Fuel oil demand from small administrative building. Operation time 50 years.
referenceFunction.name: Sorting plant for construction waste

technology.text: Construction waste sorting plants usually feature a jaw or impact crusher. Here materials from a cone crusher are inventoried. Infrastructure materials are adapted from LCI for a rock crusher for gravel production. Reduced wear and tear from lower annual throughput in construction waste sorting plant (200kt/a) is heeded.
